# GOLDEN FILE. Generated by internal/panel/golden_test.go.
# Regenerate with: bash scripts/golden-update.sh

# Every message key in the catalogue, per language. Text is deliberately
# NOT pinned: it changes often and a churning golden trains people to
# accept diffs unread. A key vanishing is the failure this file catches.
